existingAuthority.host: runRegisteredQaHostSession proves exact own Account via normal getUser and binds only that Host token into revoker; normal own local logout plus refresh rejection produces Host cleanup proof. This cannot revoke or prove cleanup of independent browser Session.
existingAuthority.browser: Reservation metadata and Receiving lease track recipient/requestedAt/one-time retrieval only. No browser Session handle, server-backed terminal receipt, wire send/verify outcome observer or fenced cancellation capability is exposed to Host wrapper.
existingAuthority.currentRelease: Before browser durable-write boundary: original Hostcleanup/noHostRequest conditions may release ownlock. At or after browserwrite boundary: lock retained irrespective of Hostclean. No complete/recovery/unlock method exists. Parent reviewed this conservative local candidate only.

stateMatrix.meaning: Even true browser login/getUser proves Session creation, not Session invalidation or completion. SameAccount is not sameSession. Host normal cleanup applies only its own Session.
stateMatrix.currentAction: Keep reservation/active.lock; no automatic terminal release.

stateMatrix.meaning: Caller status/FINISH/file boolean/absence of HTTP log is not proof no pending UI action can send. Receiver reservation and ACK do not provide a revocable send capability or trusted transport no-attempt fence.
stateMatrix.currentAction: Keep lock. Requires actual owning sender cancellation/quiescence proof bound to this reservation before any no-send terminal release; no such port now.

stateMatrix.meaning: Could have sent, or verified separately; no qualified request outcome or browser Session proof. Timeout/OTPexpiry/Receiving status does not prove cancellation or cleanup.
stateMatrix.currentAction: Keep lock and original identities; no automatic resend/refund/newlease. Owning observer must resolve actual attempt without recreating it; unresolved stays retained.

stateMatrix.meaning: UI/text/local storage clear/FINISH or HTTP404 does not prove own browser refresh revoked. Host token cleanup or sameAccount logout of another Session is insufficient.
stateMatrix.currentAction: Keep lock. Need trusted normal own-browser Session-bound logout result plus sameSession refresh rejection and sender quiescence; no token transfer or admin/global revoke.

stateMatrix.sufficientExistingEvidence: Existing in-process exact validation/cooldown failure before beforeWrite marker
stateMatrix.meaning: No browser ACK from helper; wrapper did not mark browserReservationUnresolved. This is not a successful admission or permission to send. Original Host cleanup semantics unchanged.
stateMatrix.currentAction: Original Host cleanup/noHostRequest rule only; no new complete needed.

minimumMissingOwningPort.owner: MCP browser execution/session owner; Auth only consumes a trustworthy confined result once real capability exists
minimumMissingOwningPort.boundary: An actual code-owned sender/session lifecycle observer, bound to original runId/reservation metadata and an opaque own-browser session identity. Must stop further send/verify/callback work and drain/fence in-flight actions before a terminal result. No generic caller-provided complete(status) or self-attested evidence.
minimumMissingOwningPort.terminalNotSent: Observer proves no attempted send/verify and irrevocably cancels outstanding action generation for this reservation, with no pending capability able to submit later. Must be machine-observed/enforced, not a model assertion.
minimumMissingOwningPort.terminalSessionClean: Observer proves exact same normal browser subject+session, uses that browser own in-memory credential for normal scope=local logout and actual sameSession refresh rejection, then quiesces sender. Only nonsecret verified result crosses owner boundary; raw Session/token/OTP never goes to Host.
minimumMissingOwningPort.unknown: Failed/ambiguous send, verify, logout or refresh proof is nonterminal; retain lock/original reservation. Do not invent a retry budget or admin recovery.
minimumMissingOwningPort.consumptionConstraint: Existing helpers contain no verifiable producer/authentication/fencing mechanism for such browser result. Therefore no safe completeBrowserChallenge implementation can be added from currently supplied ports alone. Parent/MCP must identify concrete owning capability before Auth designs minimal release consumer. This is a capability gap, not a new Gate request.

explicitlyInsufficient: Host Session logout or Account-level inference
next: Return matrix to parent; preserve47a3 conservative candidate and retainedlock semantics. No completion/unlock code fabricated.
